Introduction

This week, I will look at the shrunk window for all of the important stuff and then examine how state size and the other socioeconomic factors affect some of these variables and correlation, maybe look at large stats vs small states.

Metric functions

source("../metric_functions.R")

Saved datasets

hsa_state = read.csv("../hsa_state_inc.csv")
all_metrics = read_csv("../hsa_vs_state_metrics.csv")

Narrower window

Window dataset

hsa_unique = hsa_state %>%
    distinct(hsa_nci_id, state)
hsa_list = hsa_unique$hsa_nci_id

res = vector("list", length(hsa_list) * length(windows))
counter = 1

windows = list(w1 = c(1, 25), w2 = c(51, 100), w3 = c(101, Inf))

for (ID in hsa_list) {
    for (w in names(windows)) {

        bounds = windows[[w]]

        out = pivot_wider(dtw_stats(ID, start = bounds[1], end = bounds[2]),
            names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)

        out$ID = ID
        out$window = w

        res[[counter]] = out
        counter = counter + 1
    }
}

dtw_results_window = do.call(rbind, res)
dtw_results_window$window = factor(as.numeric(sub("w", "", dtw_results_window$window)),
    levels = c(1, 2, 3))
dtw_results_window = dtw_results_window %>%
    rename(peak_window = window)
dtw_results_window$peak_window = as.numeric(dtw_results_window$peak_window)

glimpse(dtw_results_window)

Ground truth

all_metrics_modified = all_metrics |>
  mutate(week_index = (epi_week + (epi_year - 2022) * 52 - 38),
    peak_window = case_when(
      week_index <= 50  ~ 1,
      week_index <= 100 ~ 2,
      TRUE              ~ 3
  ))

peak_centroid = function(x, weeks, q = 0.80) {
  threshold = quantile(x, q, na.rm = TRUE)
  mask = x >= threshold & !is.na(x)
  if (sum(mask) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(weeks[mask], x[mask])
}

truth_peaks =
  all_metrics_modified |>
  group_by(ID, state, peak_window) |>
  summarise(
    # HSA peak
    hsa_peak_week     = week_index[which.max(inc_hsa)],
    hsa_peak_value    = max(inc_hsa, na.rm = TRUE),
    hsa_centroid      = peak_centroid(inc_hsa, week_index),

    # State peak
    state_peak_week   = week_index[which.max(inc_state)],
    state_peak_value  = max(inc_state, na.rm = TRUE),
    state_centroid    = peak_centroid(inc_state, week_index),

    # Argmax differences (keep for comparison)
    truth_time_diff     = hsa_peak_week - state_peak_week,
    truth_time_diff_abs = abs(truth_time_diff),

    # Centroid difference (new)
    centroid_time_diff     = hsa_centroid - state_centroid,
    centroid_time_diff_abs = abs(centroid_time_diff),

    truth_mag_ratio = hsa_peak_value / state_peak_value,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

glimpse(truth_peaks)

Time

diff_peak_time = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(!is.na(centroid_time_diff) & !is.na(signed_lag))
timing_cor_table = diff_peak_time |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(cor_mean_abs_lag = cor(truth_time_diff_abs, mean_abs_lag,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_signed_lag = cor(truth_time_diff,
        signed_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_median_lag = cor(truth_time_diff,
        median_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_lag_sd = cor(truth_time_diff,
        lag_sd, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")
print(timing_cor_table)

timing_cor_table2 = diff_peak_time |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(cor_centroid_signed = cor(centroid_time_diff, signed_lag,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_centroid_abs = cor(centroid_time_diff_abs,
        mean_abs_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_centroid_median = cor(centroid_time_diff,
        median_lag, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")
print(timing_cor_table2)
## # A tibble: 3 × 4
##   peak_window cor_centroid_signed cor_centroid_abs cor_centroid_median

## 2           2               0.588            0.560               0.609

centroid_lm = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_time)
summary(centroid_lm)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window), 
##     data = diff_peak_time)
## 
## Residuals:
##    Min     1Q Median     3Q    Max 
## -7.247 -0.762 -0.119  0.653 34.556 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                 Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                      0.50483    0.07238   6.975 4.16e-12 ***
## signed_lag                       0.92657    0.05802  15.970  < 2e-16 ***
## factor(peak_window)2            -0.22269    0.10075  -2.210   0.0272 *  
## factor(peak_window)3            -0.18352    0.10148  -1.808   0.0707 .  
## signed_lag:factor(peak_window)2 -0.08480    0.07291  -1.163   0.2449    
## signed_lag:factor(peak_window)3 -0.19389    0.08148  -2.380   0.0174 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 1.807 on 1974 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.292,  Adjusted R-squared:  0.2902

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(centroid_lm)

diff_peak_time$pred = predict(centroid_lm, newdata = diff_peak_time)
ggplot(diff_peak_time, aes(x = signed_lag, y = centroid_time_diff,
    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_line(color = "firebrick", aes(y = pred), lwd = 1.2) +
    theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window) + labs(x = "DTW signed lag",
    y = "True timing difference (centroid)", title = "Predicted vs. true peak timing difference") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

diff_peak_time_zoom = diff_peak_time |>
    filter(signed_lag >= -10, signed_lag <= 10, centroid_time_diff >=
        -10, centroid_time_diff <= 10)

centroid_lm_zoom = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_time_zoom)

diff_peak_time_zoom$pred <- predict(centroid_lm_zoom, newdata = diff_peak_time_zoom)
ggplot(diff_peak_time_zoom, aes(x = signed_lag, y = centroid_time_diff,
    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_line(color = "firebrick", aes(y = pred), lwd = 1.2) +
    theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window) + labs(x = "DTW signed lag",
    y = "True timing difference (centroid)", title = "Predicted vs. true peak timing difference (zoomed)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

timing_cor_table2 |>
    select(peak_window, cor_centroid_signed, cor_centroid_abs,
        cor_centroid_median) |>
    pivot_longer(-peak_window, names_to = "metric", values_to = "correlation") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(peak_window), y = correlation, fill = metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") + theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Peak window", y = "Correlation with centroid time diff",
        title = "DTW timing metric correlations by window")

Magnitude

diff_peak_mag = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)  #, dtw_rmse < 5)
ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio, fill = as.factor(peak_window))) +
    geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") + geom_smooth(method = "lm",
    aes(color = as.factor(peak_window))) + facet_wrap(~peak_window) +
    theme_bw() + labs(fill = "Peak window", color = "Peak window",
    title = "Frechet vs. Truth")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", alpha = 0.4) + geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    theme_bw() + labs(title = "Frechet vs. Truth") + ylim(0,
    5) + xlim(0, 25)

US map visualization

us_map = readRDS("../us_map_pop_sf.rds")

lower48 <- setdiff(c(state.name, "District of Columbia"), c("Alaska",
    "Hawaii"))

diff_peak_map = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(signed_lag >= -10, signed_lag <= 10, centroid_time_diff >=
        -10, centroid_time_diff <= 10) |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)

## compute per-HSA correlations
hsa_cors = diff_peak_map |>
    group_by(ID, state) |>
    summarise(cor_timing = cor(signed_lag, centroid_time_diff,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_mag = cor(frechet, truth_mag_ratio,
        use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")

hsa_cors = hsa_cors |>
    mutate(composite = cor_timing + cor_mag)

us_map_plain = us_map |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::select(-geometry_hsa) |>
    filter(state %in% lower48)

us_map_cors = us_map |>
    filter(hsa_nci_id %in% us_map_plain$hsa_nci_id) |>
    left_join(hsa_cors |>
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = c("hsa_nci_id", "state"))

## map 1: timing correlation (signed_lag vs
## centroid_time_diff)
timing_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_timing), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "white",
        name = "Correlation", limits = c(-1, 1)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Timing: signed lag vs. centroid time diff")

## map 2: magnitude correlation (frechet vs
## truth_mag_ratio)
mag_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_mag), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "white",
        name = "Correlation", limits = c(-1, 1)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Magnitude: Frechet vs. truth mag ratio")

## added together map
composite_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = composite), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "white",
        name = "Composite", limits = c(-2, 2)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Composite correlation (timing + magnitude)")
timing_map/mag_map/composite_map

R^2 per window

timing_r2 = diff_peak_time |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(r2_signed_lag = summary(lm(centroid_time_diff ~
        signed_lag))$r.squared, n = n(), .groups = "drop")
print(timing_r2)

    summarise(r2_frechet = summary(lm(truth_mag_ratio ~ frechet))$r.squared,
        n = n(), .groups = "drop")

timing_r2_long = timing_r2 |>
    select(peak_window, starts_with("r2")) |>
    pivot_longer(-peak_window, names_to = "metric", values_to = "r2") |>
    mutate(model = "Timing")

magnitude_r2_long = magnitude_r2 |>
    select(peak_window, starts_with("r2")) |>
    pivot_longer(-peak_window, names_to = "metric", values_to = "r2") |>
    mutate(model = "Magnitude")

r2_combined = bind_rows(timing_r2_long, magnitude_r2_long)
ggplot(r2_combined, aes(x = factor(peak_window), y = r2, fill = metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") + facet_wrap(~model) +
    theme_bw() + labs(x = "Peak window", y = "R²", title = "R² by window and metric (timing vs. magnitude)",
    fill = "Metric")

Lag consistency

lag_consistency = diff_peak_time |>
  select(ID, state, peak_window, signed_lag, truth_time_diff) |>
  group_by(ID, state) |>
  summarise(
    n_windows        = n(),
    lag_signs        = list(sign(signed_lag)),
    all_same_sign    = length(unique(sign(signed_lag[!is.na(signed_lag)]))) == 1,
    mean_signed_lag  = mean(signed_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_signed_lag    = sd(signed_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Is DTW lag sign consistent with ground truth sign?
    lag_truth_agree  = mean(sign(signed_lag) == sign(truth_time_diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lag_consistency |>
  count(all_same_sign) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) |>
  print()
## # A tibble: 2 × 3
##   all_same_sign     n   pct
##   <lgl>         <int> <dbl>
## 1 FALSE           478  71.2
## 2 TRUE            193  28.8
us_map_lag = us_map_cors |>
  left_join(lag_consistency |> rename(hsa_nci_id = ID) |> select(hsa_nci_id, all_same_sign, mean_signed_lag, lag_truth_agree),
            by = "hsa_nci_id")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_lag), "geometry_hsa"),
          aes(fill = mean_signed_lag), color = "gray20") +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_lag), "geometry"),
          fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0,
                       na.value = "gray90", name = "Mean\nsigned lag") +
  coord_sf() + theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Mean signed lag per HSA (negative = HSA leads state)")

lag_wide = diff_peak_time |>
  select(ID, peak_window, signed_lag) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = peak_window, values_from = signed_lag,
              names_prefix = "lag_w")

cor(lag_wide[, c("lag_w1", "lag_w2", "lag_w3")], use = "pairwise.complete.obs") |>
  print()
##            lag_w1    lag_w2     lag_w3
## lag_w1  1.0000000 0.2380096 -0.1419465
## lag_w2  0.2380096 1.0000000  0.1022287
## lag_w3 -0.1419465 0.1022287  1.0000000

Magnitude consistency

mag_consistency = truth_peaks |>
    group_by(ID, state) |>
    summarise(n_windows = n(), always_above_1 = all(truth_mag_ratio >
        1, na.rm = TRUE), always_below_1 = all(truth_mag_ratio <
        1, na.rm = TRUE), consistent = always_above_1 | always_below_1,
        mean_mag_ratio = mean(truth_mag_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_mag_ratio = sd(truth_mag_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

mag_consistency |>
    count(always_above_1, always_below_1, consistent) |>
    mutate(pct = n/sum(n) * 100) |>
    print()
## # A tibble: 3 × 5
##   always_above_1 always_below_1 consistent     n   pct
##   <lgl>          <lgl>          <lgl>      <int> <dbl>
## 1 FALSE          FALSE          FALSE        289  43.1
## 2 FALSE          TRUE           TRUE          75  11.2
## 3 TRUE           FALSE          TRUE         307  45.8
truth_peaks |>
    left_join(mag_consistency |>
        select(ID, consistent, always_above_1), by = "ID") |>
    mutate(direction = case_when(always_above_1 ~ "Always HSA > State",
        !consistent ~ "Inconsistent", TRUE ~ "Always HSA < State")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(peak_window), y = truth_mag_ratio,
        fill = direction)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.7) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
    color = "firebrick") + theme_bw() + labs(x = "Peak window",
    y = "HSA / State peak ratio", title = "Magnitude ratio by window and cross-season consistency",
    fill = "Direction")
## Warning: Removed 10 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_boxplot()`).

us_map_mag = us_map_cors |>
    left_join(mag_consistency |>
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID) |>
        select(hsa_nci_id, mean_mag_ratio, consistent), by = "hsa_nci_id")

ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_mag),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = mean_mag_ratio), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_mag),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
        midpoint = 1, na.value = "gray90", name = "Mean\nmag ratio") +
    coord_sf() + theme_void() + labs(title = "Mean HSA/State magnitude ratio (red = HSA peaks higher)")

Maps with some better color scales

timing_map_div = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_timing), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "gray90",
        name = "Correlation") + coord_sf() + theme_void() + labs(title = "Timing correlation: signed lag vs. centroid time diff")

mag_map_div = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_mag), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "gray90",
        name = "Correlation") + coord_sf() + theme_void() + labs(title = "Magnitude correlation: Frechet vs. truth mag ratio")

composite_map_div = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = composite), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2, 2), na.value = "gray90",
        name = "Composite") + coord_sf() + theme_void() + labs(title = "Composite correlation score (timing + magnitude)")

timing_map_div/mag_map_div/composite_map_div

Correlation with state size and other predictors

cor_table = us_map_cors |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    select(-geometry_hsa, -geometry_county) |>
    mutate(area_ratio = area_km2_hsa/area_km2_state) |>
    distinct(hsa_nci_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(cor_timing, cor_mag, composite, pct_urban, pop_ratio,
        log_density_hsa, area_ratio) |>
    mutate(log_pop_ratio = log(pop_ratio + 1e-06), log_area_ratio = log(area_ratio +
        1e-06)) |>
    select(-pop_ratio, -area_ratio)

cor(cor_table, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")[c("cor_timing",
    "cor_mag", "composite"), c("pct_urban", "log_density_hsa",
    "log_pop_ratio", "log_area_ratio")] |>
    round(3) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = "Correlation of HSA characteristics with map correlation scores")
Correlation of HSA characteristics with map correlation scores
pct_urban log_density_hsa log_pop_ratio log_area_ratio
cor_timing 0.016 -0.121 -0.069 -0.063
cor_mag 0.026 -0.219 -0.215 -0.113
composite 0.031 -0.251 -0.213 -0.130 
cor_long = cor_table |>
    pivot_longer(c(pct_urban, log_pop_ratio, log_density_hsa,
        log_area_ratio), names_to = "predictor", values_to = "predictor_value") |>
    pivot_longer(c(cor_timing, cor_mag, composite), names_to = "outcome",
        values_to = "outcome_value")

ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = predictor_value, y = outcome_value)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm",
    color = "firebrick", se = TRUE) + facet_grid(outcome ~ predictor,
    scales = "free_x") + theme_bw() + labs(x = "Predictor value",
    y = "Correlation score", title = "Regression of HSA correlation scores on HSA characteristics")
